messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Portuguese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Portuguese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
64 Quando vi este homem no grande deserto, 65 “Tem piedade de mim!” gritei a ele, 66 “Seja o que fores sombra ou homem certo!”

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|-----------------------|--------| | Quando | temporal conjunction “when” | Quando | when | OK | | vidi | 1st sg passato remoto “saw” | vi | I saw | OK | | costui | demonstrative pronoun “him / this one” | este homem | this man | OK | | nel | preposition + definite article “in the” | no | in the | OK | | gran | adjective “great, large” | grande | great | OK | | diserto | noun “desert” | deserto | desert | OK | | Miserere | imperative “have pity” | **Tem piedade** | have pity | OK | | di | preposition “on / of” | de | of | OK | | me | 1st sg pronoun “me” | mim | me | OK | | gridi | 1st sg passato remoto “cried, shouted” | gritei | I shouted | OK | | a | preposition “to” | a | to | OK | | lui | 3rd sg pronoun “him” | ele | him | OK | | qual | relative pronoun “whatever / what” | o que | what | OK | | che | relative particle linking *qual* to the clause | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | tu | 2nd sg pronoun “you” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | sii | subjunctive of *essere* “be” (2nd sg) | **Seja** | be | **GRAMMAR** (should be *Sejas* for 2nd sg) | | od | coordinating conjunction “or” | ou | or | OK | | ombra | noun “shade” | sombra | shade | OK | | od | coordinating conjunction “or” (second occurrence) | ou | or | OK | | omo | noun “man” | homem | man | OK | | certo | adjective “certain / real” | certo | certain | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention
- **UNNECESSARY**: *che*, *tu* – Italian uses a relative particle and an explicit pronoun that Portuguese does not need; they are omitted naturally. - **GRAMMAR**: *sii* → “Seja”. In Portuguese the 2nd‑person singular subjunctive of *ser* is **sejas**, not *seja*. The current translation contains an agreement error.
All other source tokens are correctly rendered in the Portuguese version.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Portuguese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Portuguese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 64** - Original: Quando vi este homem no grande deserto, - Issue: none - Corrected: Quando vi este homem no grande deserto,
- **Line 65** - Original: “Tem piedade de mim!” gritei a ele, - Issue: none - Corrected: “Tem piedade de mim!” gritei a ele,
- **Line 66** - Original: “Seja o que fores sombra ou homem certo!” - Issue: GRAMMAR – “Seja” and “fores” are 3rd‑person forms; they must be 2nd‑person singular subjunctive. - Corrected: “Sejas o que sejas sombra ou homem certo!”
``` Quando vi este homem no grande deserto, “Tem piedade de mim!” gritei a ele, “Sejas o que sejas sombra ou homem certo!” ```
